verdict.summary: The added helper safely converts non-AssertionError escapes into observable self-test values, preventing a malformed mutant from aborting the remaining checks and being misclassified as a kill. Its control rows exercise both the escape-reporting path and the normal refusal/accept paths. The two new seam mutants independently reach and pin the previously uncovered first-line and shlex-tokenisation refusal branches using branch-unique message fragments. The changes are confined to self-test support, preserve the production fail-closed assertions, and introduce no apparent security or trust-check weakening.
